informal_statement: The nonnegative integral of \(2\sqrt{r^2-(y-a)^2}\) over \([a+r\cos\theta,a+r]\) equals \(r^2(\theta-\sin\theta\cos\theta)\), for \(r>0\) and \(0\leq\theta\leq\pi\).
